2.t: And by the night when it is stillest,

3.t: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,

4.t: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,

5.t: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.

6.t: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?

7.t: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?

8.t: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?

10.t: Therefor the beggar drive not away,

11.t: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
